items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Yes he did, Syl Austin and all those other guys got a chance to go over there.

ctx.x:
Yeah, Sam did have tremendous success,
and it certainly is nice to hear that about Sam Taylor in
Japan. And he probably opened the way for a lot of other guys
because ...

Yes he did, Syl Austin and all those
other guys got a chance to go over there.

Yeah, a lot of guys were going to Japan
and doing very well. I know of many people going over there.
I was there with Louie Armstrong many years back, and I really
enjoyed that country very much.
